title: MV Looking for a plugin that gives enemies dice roll HP ranges.

posts.author: Starsmooth
posts.body:
Is there a plugin for RPG maker MV that replicates how HP is handled in games like Wizardry where all enemies have HP ranges based on a dice roll.
The way it works is that every enemy has a dice roll assigned to them, for example, an enemy that has 20-110 HP will have the dice roll formula: (10d10+10).
this formula represents: Ten ten sided dice + 10
I imagine that you could put this formula into an enemy's notes area if there is no plugin like this exists.

posts.author: caethyril
